searches.reason: Test whether SASRec’s single-negative objective leaves difficult candidates poorly ranked, especially in Electronics. Seek practical multi-negative objectives and false-negative controls; compare using the pinned macro validation HR@10 because training margins alone do not establish ranking quality.

searches.reason: Explore replacing one sequence representation with adaptive short-term and persistent-interest components. Recent and repeated interactions may distinguish current intent from isolated purchases; timestamp-aware routing offers a feasible starting point without assuming observed intent labels.

searches.reason: Investigate learning complementary versus substitutable item relationships from training interactions and available titles/descriptions. A lightweight relation-aware graph or auxiliary encoder could improve specific matches without external pretrained weights; compatibility must remain a hypothesis rather than an inferred fact.
